comments.body: Looks like a theme park sim lol. I guess this is a benchmark for RL agents, right? How‘s it called?

comments.author: ShivEater
comments.body:
Unironically, this is the exact problem people run into with AI tools.  To produce quality content, you need a discerning eye.  It's a feedback loop where you make something, evaluate it critically, and then change it to be better.  AI tools externalize a portion of this process, which can interrupt the feedback loop.

The thing is, this isn't more fun than most games.  Your ability to discern the quality of what you have made is failing.  If you put this on steam right now, it would sell ~0 copies.  And that's ok!  This is part of the process. 

Because the tool can create content outside of that feedback loop, it's entirely up to you to look at the result with a critical eye.  It is extra important that you do this self critique with AI tools, because by using the tool, you have skipped many internal rounds of self critique already.
